=== 100x32 ===
           ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮           
           │                                                                            │           
           │  moomux commands                                                           │           
           │                                                                            │           
           │  Sessions                            Navigation                            │           
           │    n          new session              ↑ / k              move up          │           
           │    f          find session (all        ↓ / j              move down        │           
           │               projects)                shift+↑↓ / KJ      reorder session  │           
           │    enter / o  open (attach tmux)       tab / ] / →        next project     │           
           │    x          park (kill tmux)         shift+tab / [ / ←  prev project     │           
           │    d          delete worktree          } / {              ...incl. empty   │           
           │    a          archive session                             ones             │           
           │    A          show archived            shift+←→ / HL      reorder project  │           
           │    t          tag ticket / PR          R                  force-copy       │           
           │    e          edit session                                ticket/PR        │           
           │    D          diff tool                                   links: off       │           
           │    g          file into a folder                                           │           
           │    z          collapse its folder                                          │           
           │    G          manage folders                                               │           
           │                                                                            │           
           │                                                                            │           
           │  Projects                            General                               │           
           │    /      pick project                 ?  toggle this help                 │           
           │    n/e/d  add/edit/remove (picker)     q  quit                             │           
           │                                        r  refresh                          │           
           │                                        s  settings (theme, sort mode,      │           
           │                                           auto-tmux, auto-submit, diff     │           
           │                                           tool)                            │           
           │                                                                            │           
           │  ↑↓/jk/pg scroll  ?/esc close                                              │           
           │                                                                            │
